body_markdown:
Real-time insurance verification is essential for law enforcement officers and DMV staff.


Unfortunately, Kansas officers and staff lacked a real-time insurance verification system, instead relying on monthly insurance reports that could be out of date at the time of verification.


###### Real-Time Insurance Verification


It was time for a change, so MV Solutions, a subsidiary of i3 Verticals, was selected by the Kansas Department of Insurance to launch the


[Kansas Insurance Verification System (KSIVS)](https://go.i3verticals.com/MVS-KSIVS) .


KSIVS verifies insurance coverage in real time using the Kansas Department of Revenue’s motor vehicle records and data from 317 insurance companies. After the system receives the verification request, it matches the VIN to insurance company records, confirms if liability insurance is active, and returns a real-time verification response to the officer or DMV staff member.


The secure, web-based system:


- Streamlines traffic stops and registration renewals


- Improves roadside safety and insurance verification accuracy


- Identifies fraud, including attempts to obtain insurance after a crash and falsely claiming coverage existed beforehand


- Reduces the number of uninsured motorists on the road


###### Minimal Operational Impact


KSIVS has also resulted in very minor operational changes for law enforcement and motorists.


Officers run license plates or VINs as they always have, and drivers are still required to maintain liability insurance whether on paper or a mobile device.


###### Raising The Bar


Since its founding in 2006, MV Solutions has raised the standard for real-time insurance verification. i3 Verticals is excited to partner with MV Solutions to continue to bring industry-leading insurance verification to our customers, including continuing to work with Kansas officials to develop an enforcement mechanism targeting uninsured drivers.


i3 and MV Solutions’ combined expertise and complete, end-to-end insurance compliance program deliver necessary, integrated tools for improving operations and roadside safety.
